owner: University of Guelma / ICE Informatique et Communication d'Entreprises
notes: ICE corporate presentation states it delivered an HPC project at the University of Guelma in 2012: a 32-node Intel/Linux cluster, electrical/physical audit, deployment plan, 30 kVA UPS, software and admin training.
